workflow.rule: Sélectionner une seule carte queued, la passer active, installer et tester uniquement cette variante WED, puis enregistrer la preuve QA exacte avant de passer à la suivante.

treatment.evidence: every active liquid WED has an ingame validation receipt under pipeline/water/manifests (commit f4f52a71)

review.principle: Game INI WaterOverlayStrength = 1.00 (neutral cap). Route2 q is set per WED identity in the registry (DLL). Every map is re-checked visually to assign its own dry q, already validated maps included; rain variants of weather maps and night WEDs are re-checked too. Rain identities stay q0 unless a rain review decides otherwise.
